description: This file defines several Pydantic models for incident data transfer objects (DTOs) used within an incident reporting backend system. It includes models for creating, updating, reading, and listing incidents, likely to be used in API request/response schemas.

classes.name: IncidentCreate
classes.description: Schema for creating a new incident, including title, description, severity, and status.

classes.name: IncidentUpdate
classes.description: Schema for updating an existing incident, allowing optional fields for partial updates.

classes.name: IncidentRead
classes.description: Schema for reading incident details, includes UUID, timestamps, and other incident info.

classes.name: IncidentListResponse
classes.description: Schema representing a list of incident records with pagination info.
